paite: Michih atung ua vaihawm thuneite thuthu in om hen. Pathian thu lou in kuamah thunei a-om ngal kei ua; vaihawm thunei mite zaw Pathian seh ahi uh.
heading: Kumpi Vaihawmte Thumanna
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

paite: Huaiziak in kuapeuh vaihawmmi sel Pathian sehkalh ahi a, aselte'n amau tung ah vaihawmna akimuh ding uhi.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

paite: Vaihawmte thil hoih hihte ding in kihtakhuai ahi kei ua; thil hoih lou hihte a ding in bel kihtakhuai ahi uhi. Ahihleh vaihawmmi kihta lou a om na ut uhia? Thil hoih hih le uchin phat na loh ding uh.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

paite: Amah tuh na hoihna ding ua Pathian nasemmi ahi ngal a. Himahleh kihta un, namsau lah amawk tawi ngal kei a; amah Pathian nasemmi, thil hihkhialmi tung a heh a phulami ahi.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian hehna kihtakna ziak kia hilou in, na sia-le-pha theihna ziak lel ua leng na kituklut ding uh ahi.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

paite: Hiai ziak in siah leng na liau zel ve ua le; huchibang thil ngei hih teitei ding in Pathian nasem mite ahi uhi.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

paite: Mi tengteng kiang ah piak ding peuhmah pia un; leiman piakna ding kiang ah leiman pia unla, siah liauna dingpa kiang ah siah liau unla; kihtak dingpa leng kihta unla; zahtak dingpa leng zahtak un.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

paite: Ki-ittuahna lou ngal kuamah bangmah ba kei un; amau mihinpih itpa'n dan azuikimta hi.
heading: Unau Ki-itna
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

paite: Hiaite, "Ang kawm ke'n, Tualthat ke'n, Gu ke'n, Eng ke'n," chih leh thupiak dang om lai himhimte, "Nangmah na ki-it bang in na invengte na it ding ahi,” chih in akhaikhawm vek hi.
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

paite: Itna in a-invengte ahihse ngei kei a; huaiziak in itna zaw dan zuihkimna ahi.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

paite: Huai lou in, tu bang hun ahia chih na thei ua, ihmu khanloh a hun mahmahta chih na thei uhi. Tu'n zaw i gintak tung lai sang in i hotdamna anai zawta ngal a.
heading: Khrist Ni Hong Naina
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

paite: Zan abei dekdekta a, khua avak dekta hi; huaiziak in mial a thilhihte paikhia in vak thuam in i kithuam ding uh.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

paite: Sun a om bang in kilawmtak in i om ding uh, zu dawn buai leh zu kham a om lou in, huk leh kingaihhat a om lou in, kilai leh kihaza a om lou in.
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist in kithuam zaw unla, na sa duhgawlna uh pichin ding in bangmah kibawl kei un.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
